definitions: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.
To meet specified standards or requirements.
examples: All employees must comply with the company's safety regulations.
The new software needs to conform to industry standards.
He struggled to comply with the strict dress code.
The building design must conform to local zoning laws.
lemma: to comply with; to conform to
pastTenses: complied with; conformed to, complied with; have conformed to
source: to comply with; to conform to
